decisions.reason: Because this close-to-core finisher was shown in 2023 but disappeared from the website in 2024, its visible market result likely fell below aspiration and does not justify continued resource commitment despite some portfolio slack.

This UV spot varnishing system was both distant from the firm’s established offer and no longer mentioned after its 2023 launch event, indicating underperformance relative to aspiration and a weak enough fit that resources should be redirected.

The sheet preparation module remained on its own page in both 2023 and 2024, so it appears to meet or stay close enough to aspiration within the firm’s core automation path to merit continued support.

Although close to the established offer, the B2-format multifinisher was promoted at launch in 2023 and then vanished from the website in 2024, suggesting results below aspiration and a decision to reallocate effort to stronger lines.

The hybrid saddle stitcher had a dedicated page in 2023 but was not mentioned in 2024, which signals that observed demand likely did not meet aspiration levels strongly enough to keep it in the range.
The folding add-on unit was still mentioned in 2024 and had a concrete customer-use reference from 2023, indicating acceptable early adoption and enough fit with the core portfolio to continue.
